name: Grunt
prompt: Create ONE isolated full-body character concept of GRUNT, the krogan from Mass Effect, using these official EA/BioWare costume guides as the exact character and equipment references. ONE figure in a three-quarter profile facing SCREEN RIGHT. Preserve the reference krogan anatomy: broad massive torso, hump-backed armored silhouette, short heavy neck, distinctive rough gray-brown ridged head crest, red-orange orbital skin, pale gold folded muzzle/chin, small blue eyes, exposed textured orange upper arms, large low-set shoulders, three-digit hands and the exact wide armored toes shown. He is Grunt, not Wrex, not Drack; preserve his own face and clean recognizable crest. Reproduce the guide's weathered pale gray/silver armor with dark undersuit joints, the layered shoulder shells, wide upper chest plate with its small narrow blue light, central circular blue abdominal light, segmented side braces, silver forearm guards, broad thigh shells with circular blue details, heavy dark-rimmed knee fittings and short shin guards, correct armored back hump as visible from this angle. Match the reference plate shapes, proportions, divisions and silver/black color placement; do not replace them with generic armor. Pose a quiet braced ready stance, head looking right, knees slightly bent, feet planted and separated, arms held naturally low with fingers readable and clear of the torso. Do not hold a weapon or activate effects. Full character visible from top of crest through every toe, centered with generous transparent margin, entire figure at most eighty-two percent of canvas height. Realistic high-detail Mass Effect game-character illustration, even neutral studio lighting, clear material separation and crisp silhouette. Single character single view only, not a sheet or collage. No caption, no scenery, no platform, no floor, no ground shadow, no decorative border. TRUE transparent alpha background; do not reproduce the colorful guide backdrop and do not draw a checkerboard.
